skills.name: Focus Drawn Long
skills.effect: volley shots at targets beyond half the firing ship's range gain +20% damage.
skills.original: Focus Drawn Long - volley shots at targets beyond half the firing ship's range gain +20% damage.

contract.actor: Each player non-squadron ship firing the primary Burning glass Command
contract.target: The actual target chosen for this weapon by the existing Command targeting
contract.trigger: Immediately before a primary-Command weapon resolves
contract.resolution: Multiply that weapon shot damage by 1.20 only if hex distance is strictly greater than half its printed maximum range
contract.limit: Once as a damage multiplier per eligible weapon; not an extra shot
contract.stacking: Multiply the existing Command multiplier once; no effect on normal fire, boss Commands or alternate Command
contract.cleanup: Restore the original battle multiplier in finally, including aborted or thrown actions
contract.playerInput: Weapon eligibility follows the existing Command; no additional target override
contract.note: Evidence is verbatim extraction; hook tags are suggestions. Null fields must not be defaulted into game behavior.

skills.interpretationNote: A single shot means one projectile from a selected weapon entry; “ship range” is interpreted as that weapon’s printed maximum r. These terms are proposed clarifications, not silent edits to the source.

skills.name: One Lens, One Target
skills.effect: a ship may fire its volley as a single shot at +25% damage instead of firing every gun.
skills.original: One Lens, One Target - a ship may fire its volley as a single shot at +25% damage instead of firing every gun.

contract.actor: Each player non-squadron ship with an explicit focused-weapon selection
contract.target: The actual legal target chosen by the existing Command for that weapon
contract.trigger: Before iterating a ship’s primary-Command weapons
contract.resolution: For a ship choosing one weapon index, fire a single projectile from that weapon during the Command at 1.25 damage; null/omitted selection keeps its normal volley
contract.limit: One projectile from one chosen weapon per ship; native shot count restored afterward
contract.stacking: Multiply existing Command damage once; only one A1 option can be owned
contract.cleanup: Restore normal weapons/cooldowns/post-fire movement and the original battle multiplier; consume intent with Command
contract.playerInput: Per ship: normal volley, or one weapon index. Cancel does not spend Command
contract.note: Evidence is verbatim extraction; hook tags are suggestions. Null fields must not be defaulted into game behavior.

skills.interpretationNote: A single shot means one projectile from a selected weapon entry; “ship range” is interpreted as that weapon’s printed maximum r. These terms are proposed clarifications, not silent edits to the source.
